name: build a fully functioning land surveying

messages.content: build a fully functioning land surveying android application meant to replace field notes, establish a live aol instant messenger style chat that links cad operators and field crew, keeps track of jobs and a checklist of what has been done and what's left to do. as well as uploading, downloading, and drawing line work.

I stopped after 30 minutes without getting anywhere.

Anything I had already written is still here. This usually means the model I was
using has no capacity left this week — try another one from the model picker — or
that the task is a big one, in which case ask for it a step at a time.
